comparison.objective: Screen ceramic media from metal washers, versus untying a loose overhand knot.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid granular flow and bimanual screen control versus deformable-cord loop identification, loosening and end extraction.
comparison.success_condition: At least 98% recovery with washers retained versus knot eliminated and cord left in the required released state.
comparison.reason: The tested physical abilities are substantially different despite both permitting bimanual work.
